learning_objectives_zh: 通过 8 个核心词群（涵盖今日 27 个目标词条）掌握熟悉词汇的学术熟词生义（Polysemy）、一词多义边界、可数/及物性变化与自然搭配。

grammar_instruction.name: 时态、体与学术论文各章节的方法论时间分工
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 学术论文的时态传递方法论状态：一般过去时描述本研究特定实验步骤与过去采样结果；一般现在时描述数学定义、图表展示内容、模型架构属性及本文篇章导引；现在完成时总结某领域迄今的研究演进或前文已完成论证。
rules: 描述本研究特定数据集采集、预处理步骤与单次实验观测用一般过去时（The team abandoned the approach; Two analysts analysed the data independently）。
描述数学性质、算法机制、图表内容及普遍事实用一般现在时（The affine function f(x) = ax + b includes an intercept b; Table 1 shows...）。
描述近十年研究趋势或前文已展现的内容用现在完成时（The field has developed in recent years; As we have seen, the two estimates use different denominators）。
examples: The team accessed the database before the policy changed.
A weakly stationary process has a constant finite mean and autocovariance that depends only on the lag.
As has been shown in Table 2, attendance varied by site.
common_errors: 把尚未开展的 Future Work 写成已完成的一般过去时。
在明确过去时间状语（during the pilot）下误用现在完成时。

grammar_instruction.name: 数值、比例、分位数、矩阵量纲与增减幅度的精确语法
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 定量描述必须严格区分“差值（by）”、“终值（to）”、“比例（proportion/percentage）”、“比值（ratio）”、“百分点（percentage points）”以及“均值（mean）、中位数（median）、众数（mode）、中程数（midrange）”。
rules: 动词 + by + 差值（decreased by 5 units） vs 动词 + to + 终值（decreased to 15）；名词 + of + 变化量（growth of 10%） vs 名词 + in + 变化对象（growth in demand）。
从 20% 升至 25% 是 an increase of 5 percentage points（绝对百分点变化），而相对增幅为 25%（relative percentage change）。
double 表示增至两倍，halve 表示减半（不可写 *halve by half）；midrange 是 (min+max)/2，median 是排序后居中的分位数（0.5 quantile），二者绝不可混同。
examples: The count increased by ten, from twenty to thirty.
A rise from 20% to 25% is five percentage points.
For the values 7, 8, 8, 8, 11 and 12, the midrange is 9.5, whereas the median is 8.
common_errors: 介词 by 与 to 混用导致差值与终值颠倒。
把 percentage point（百分点）与 per cent（百分比）混同。

grammar_instruction.name: 状语从句、让步/条件结构与介词短语的紧凑转换
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 掌握从属连词（although, whereas, while, provided that, because, in that）、介词短语（despite, in spite of, due to, prior to, in light of, in the absence of）与连接副词（nevertheless, nonetheless, consequently, conversely）之间的句法转换。
rules: 让步压缩：Although the approach has limitations -> Albeit with limitations / Despite its limitations（严禁写 *despite of）。
条件限定：provided that / as long as + 完整分句 <-> subject to / under + 名词短语。
对照结构：whereas / while 连接两个对称分句（The first model uses monthly data, whereas the second uses daily data）。
examples: The approach is informative, albeit with limitations.
The result applies provided that the assumptions hold.
The estimate remains uncertain despite the larger sample.
common_errors: 混淆介词与连词：*despite the sample is large。
while 表对比时与时间含义发生歧义（在时序/并发场景中表对比优先用 whereas）。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 章节过渡与Given-New指代衔接（This + 总结名词）
expression_pattern_instruction.template: This [discrepancy/limitation/pattern] motivates our next analysis, where we turn to [next topic] in greater detail.
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 用 This + 范畴名词总结上句结果并自然开启下一句或下一节。
examples: An anomaly in the sensor readings prompted a check of the calibration procedure.
We now turn to the evaluation criteria.
common_errors: 使用指代不清的裸 This 作主语。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 具身智能（Embodied AI）与机器人：空间表征、轨迹跟踪与物理约束
expression_pattern_instruction.template: To bridge the discrepancy between simulation and real-world deployment, the policy enforces [physical/monotonicity constraints] while adapting to [sensor noise / external perturbations].
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 用于具身智能、机器人控制与视觉导航写作，准确表达仿真到真实迁移（sim-to-real）、空间方位（spatial orientation）与速度/运动学约束。
examples: The optimization procedure enforces a non-negativity constraint on the weights while tracking the trajectory.
The sensitivity analysis examines the effect of a small perturbation to the input sensor readings.
common_errors: 把仿真器（simulation）中的理想合成观测（synthetic data）直接等同于真实物理传感器的含噪观测。

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00369 phr. v.] 开展；执行（例：The researchers carried out a survey of commuting habits.）；[V00370 phr.v.] 开展；实施（例：The team carried out interviews with local residents.）；[V00371 phrase] 实施，开展（例：The team carried out a survey of local residents.）；[V00372 v. phrase] 开展（例：The team carried out a follow-up study.） | 本条用法约束：carry out research/an experiment/an analysis。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: An independent team carried out the analysis.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：make the case for表示提出支持某个立场的理由，不表示物理位置。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The report makes the case for transparent reporting.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：可用于深入理解个案，未必具有统计代表性。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The case study examined one school's response to a curriculum change.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：介词 on，不写 to；质疑不等于已经证伪。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The replication failure casts doubt on the original claim.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：cause-and-effect 作前置定语通常连字符连接。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The survey alone cannot establish a cause-and-effect relationship.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：须有每一事件引起下一事件的链条，不能只指同时发生。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The initial fault set off a chain reaction in the system.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：in说明变化的方面。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: We measured a change in temperature.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：of常说明以新事物替换原事物。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The failure prompted a change of approach.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：in引出发生变化的量或方面；此处changes为名词。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: We measured changes in water temperature.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：固定介词 of。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Long dry intervals are characteristic of the region's climate.
